title: Moment of Inertia
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly derive and state the moment of inertia I = (1/12) ml^2.

title: Lagrange's Equations
description: Important Criteria: The student must correctly formulate Lagrange's equations for the system involving the coordinates x and theta.

title: Instability Explanation
description: Important Criteria: The student must explain the instability of the rod's position and describe its subsequent motion when disturbed.

title: Final Velocities
description: Essential Criteria: The student must correctly identify the final angular and radial velocities of the rod after a long time.

title: Coordinate Choice
description: Optional Criteria: The student should justify the choice of coordinates for the system.

title: Common Errors
description: Pitfall Criteria: The student should avoid common errors such as incorrect signs or missing factors in the equations.
